findings.finding: Q2 2026 Vector grew ~23% q/q against management's own 12-13% plan, after ~15% for four straight quarters, once runtime engine data began feeding the models at the end of Q2; the Q3 guide (strategic Grow $380-385m) implies only 19-21% Vector q/q, i.e. a guide set below the first quarter that carried runtime data for part of the period and before a full quarter of it, so a Grow beat above the $385m top end is the base case on the company's own trajectory.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This stock has paid for Vector beats: 2025-11-05 +18.09% and 2026-08-06 +15.05% (Vector +23% q/q vs 12-13% plan, guide raised). It has not paid for a beat with a weak guide: 2026-02-11 -26.32% on a weak Q1 revenue outlook despite a beat; 2026-05-07 -2.02% on a pre-announced quarter.
findings.why_not_priced: Sell-side revenue consensus ($565.5m) sits exactly on the guide midpoint and was unchanged for 30 days, so published estimates carry no Vector upside beyond the company's own 19-21%; if the market had priced a 23%+ Vector quarter the consensus would sit at or above the top of the range and the skew would not be paying for downside. The partial-price caveat: the buy side almost certainly expects a beat (BofA's >20% call is public), so only a beat well above ~$385m Grow moves the stock.
findings.independence: Call summaries put Vector at +23% q/q vs 12-13% expected and the runtime-data start at end of Q2 (https://www.benzinga.com/node/62182451, transcript of the same call, so same event). Separate document: BofA note of 2026-08-07 calling the Q3 Grow guide conservative and expecting >20% q/q (https://www-web.itiger.com/news/2657642686), used in the guidance finding below.

findings.finding: BofA (upgrade to Buy, PT $30 to $50, 2026-08-07) says only games built on Unity 6 currently feed runtime data into Vector and Unity is extending coverage to older engine versions, and expects Vector >20% q/q in both Q3 and Q4 with a runway through year-end 2027; a Q4 Grow guide that implies continued ~20% Vector sequential growth into the seasonally strongest ad quarter would confirm that runway, and the Q4 guide is the line this name reprices on.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance decides this stock's prints: 2026-02-11 -26.32% on a Q1 revenue outlook below expectations despite a beat; 2026-08-06 +15.05% on a Q3 Grow guide BofA said beat investor expectations; 2025-11-05 +18.09% on an upbeat outlook.
findings.why_not_priced: No Q4 consensus was found in any source, so the bar for the guide is unsourced and this finding is capped small. The stock is 14.8% below its high and fell 7.3% over 20 days, which is not what a market already holding a ~20% Q4 Vector guide would look like on a name whose last two Vector guides each re-rated it 15-18%; the put skew says the market fears the guide more than it expects it.
findings.independence: Analyst inference from a company disclosure, not a company number. Unity's own pull-forward of GAAP profitability to Q3 (Q2 release) and Vector reaching a >$1bn run rate two quarters early (https://www.benzinga.com/node/62182451) point the same way but are the Q2 event already in the price.

findings.finding: AppLovin filed a JAMS arbitration demand (2026-09-27) and a San Francisco Superior Court petition (2026-09-28) alleging Unity's Ad Quality SDK collected data on ads AppLovin serves through MAX and, on information and belief, used it to train competing auction models; Unity had offered to wind down Ad Quality's collection on MAX-mediated auctions, a TRO was reported denied (2026-10-02) and the dispute moves to private arbitration; the Q3 call is the first time management can be asked whether the wind-down or the arbitration touches Vector's data inputs.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print has carried this line. On the 2026-10-02 report of the TRO denial Unity rose more than 6% and AppLovin fell 5% to a 52-week low, so the market read the first ruling as a Unity win.
findings.why_not_priced: The TRO denial was priced as a win (+6%), but the arbitration merits, the scope of Unity's offered wind-down and any disclosure of a loss contingency or a change in Vector training data are unknown and would first surface on this call or in the 10-Q; if the market saw no risk the skew would not be paying for downside on a name that has beaten for three quarters. Sized small because Unity says Ad Quality 'isn't the driver of our improved performance' and a TRO was refused.
findings.independence: TRO denial and Wedbush's view that more aggressive Unity bidding in MAX could compress AppLovin's take rate (https://parameter.io/applovin-app-shares-plunge-60-ytd-as-judge-sides-with-unity-in-data-dispute/, 2026-10-02); pocketgamer and mobilegamer covered the filing (https://www.pocketgamer.biz/applovin-takes-legal-action-against-unity-over-ad-quality-sdk/).

findings.finding: AppLovin, Unity's direct competitor in mobile UA, is listed by Earnings Whispers to report Q3 2026 after the close on 2026-11-04 (other calendars show 11-09 or 11-11; not confirmed by the company in anything fetched) against its own Q3 guide of $2.055-2.085bn revenue and ~$2.07-2.08bn consensus, after a Q2 revenue miss and a soft Q3 guide that sent APP down ~16-21% on 2026-08-05; the read-through sign for Unity is two-way, because on the last print APP's miss and Unity's beat arrived together and were read as share shift.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-08-05 APP fell ~16-21% after hours on a revenue miss and soft guide; Unity printed the next morning and rose 15.05%. Mobile ad strength at APP and Unity's share gain are not the same signal, so the read-through has carried no reliable sign.
findings.why_not_priced: If it lands on 11-04 amc it is inside the window and unknowable at the baseline seal (13:09 ET), so nothing about it can be in the price; its content is unknown to this hunt, so it is sized 0 with a wide band. If APP reports later it moves to outside_window.
findings.independence: AppLovin's Q3 guide from its Q2 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001751008/000175100826000057/app-20260805.htm); the announce-date release exists but was 403 (https://www.morningstar.com/news/business-wire/20261007894147/applovin-to-announce-third-quarter-2026-results).

findings.finding: Insiders made 17 open-market sales and no purchases over six months (CEO Bromberg ~$4.5m, CFO Yahes ~$1.8m), with a cluster of Form 144s filed 2026-08-25 to 08-31 after the Q2 print and a Form 4 on 2026-10-15; there has been no insider buying at any price on the 146% run off the low.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No measured link between Unity insider sales and its print reactions; the 2026-08 sales followed a +15% print.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the filings are public and most such sales are scheduled. Filed small because the pattern is one-way and the CEO also received an 880k-PPSU award with $50/$60/$75 price hurdles (8-K 2026-08-19), which aligns him with the upside and cuts against reading the sales as a signal.
findings.independence: https://www.quiverquant.com/news/Unity+Software+Slides+as+Macro+Pressure+Appears+to+Outweigh+Recent+Company+Momentum (2026-10-14) gives the 17/0 count and dollar sizes; the PPSU award is https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1810806/000181080626000046/unity-20260817.htm.

findings.finding: Management pulled its first GAAP net-income quarter forward from Q4 to Q3 2026 and guided adj. EBITDA $185-190m (~33% margin, ~400 bps of operating-margin expansion in Q3); a first GAAP profit is a headline item but it sits inside what the company already guided.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Margin beats have accompanied the two positive Vector prints (+18%, +15%) but were not the line that moved them.
findings.why_not_priced: It is inside the company's own guide, so the market was told to expect it; only a miss of GAAP profitability would be news.
findings.independence: The EBITDA guide is in the Q2 release (https://s205.q4cdn.com/200788659/files/doc_news/Unity-Reports-Second-Quarter-2026-Financial-Results-2026.pdf), same event.

findings.finding: Unity plans to repay its convertible notes due November 2026 from cash, against $2,357m of cash and restricted cash at 2026-06-30 and $202m of Q2 free cash flow, which removes the maturity without new financing or dilution.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No print has turned on the converts since the 2025 refinancing.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the cash balance and the plan are public. Signed positive after asking what the money buys: it is a maturity paid from operating cash, not a raise, so it is a zero to small positive.
findings.independence: Cash balance from the Q2 release (https://s205.q4cdn.com/200788659/files/doc_news/Unity-Reports-Second-Quarter-2026-Financial-Results-2026.pdf).
